title: EasyLern
tagline: EasyLern is a decentralized learning platform which uses some unique methods to ensure a safe and happy learning environment in a trustless environment.
description: Education platforms which exists currently are limited to teachers or courses from reputed universities. There should be a wider range of courses available to people. Everyone has something to teach and what better way than earning some money for it. Taking these two factors into account, there exists a dire need of a new kind of skill sharing platform. The platform connects people from all over the world so that people can learn from each other.People using the platform are of usually two types- the learner and the trainer.A person can be both a traine and a learner in the same time. A learner can use the platform for buying a course at a specified cost or can request a course he wants to learn.
how_its_made: Maintaining course content and quality is one of the key ideas that needed solving. A new design of subscription model with streaming payments was chosen.
